v1.feedback: The L-system tree form is recognizable and the soap-bubble swerve off the beam parent is conceptually strong. However, the tip color vec3(0.85,0.95,0.55) risks reading as vivid chartreuse once boosted by the 1.0+1.2*inBeam multiplier — pull green down to ~0.75 and nudge toward warm ochre (0.80,0.72,0.45) to stay in earth-tone territory. The volumetric cone at alpha 0.08 is tastefully subtle but its hard geometric silhouette could benefit from a noise-driven edge falloff so it reads as atmospheric haze rather than a literal cone mesh. Consider seeding bubble spawn points more visibly along branch tips so the soap-bubble concept reads in the first two seconds rather than requiring the viewer to track individual floaters.

v2.feedback: Strong pairing of stochastic L-system tree (a confirmed preferred form) with iridescent soap bubbles at branch tips — the surprise word genuinely drives the design rather than being decorative. The earth-tone bark-to-moss gradient and soft volumetric beam read as contemplative; bubble iridescence via MeshPhysicalMaterial at IOR 1.35 adds spectral color without breaking the restrained palette. To refine: consider scaling bubble radius inversely with generation depth so outer-tip bubbles feel more delicate and varied, and add a subtle upward float drift to detached bubbles so the soap-bubble metaphor completes — right now they sit static at tips, which undersells the word.
